output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the recipient contract is a contract and if it implements the onTransferStack function. This could lead to a reentrancy attack where the recipient contract could call back into the Cryptogs contract and transfer tokens again, leading to an infinite loop.

The transfer function does not check if the recipient contract has enough balance to receive the token. This could lead to an integer overflow attack where the recipient contract could receive more tokens than intended.
The transfer function does not check if the sender owns the token. This could lead to a security vulnerability where an attacker could transfer a token they do not own.
The transferFrom function does not check if the sender is approved to transfer the token. This could lead to a security vulnerability where an attacker could transfer a token they do not own.
The approve function does not check if the sender owns the token. This could lead to a security vulnerability where an attacker could approve a transfer of a token they do not own.
The balanceOf function does not check if the sender is the owner of the tokens. This could lead to a security vulnerability where an attacker could view the balance of a different owner's tokens.
